title: dsamoht/clustermg pipeline parameters
description: Dereplicated MAGs and a MAG-anchored non-redundant gene catalog from metagenome assemblies

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to the comma-separated sample sheet: one row per assembly, with its bins and their CheckM2 report.
input.help_text: Columns `name,assembly,bins,checkm2`. `bins` is a directory of MAG FASTA files and `checkm2` the CheckM2 `quality_report.tsv` that covers them; leave both empty for an assembly that only contributes genes. A relative path is looked up in the launch directory, then next to the sample sheet. See docs/usage.md.

reads.description: Path to the comma-separated sheet of read libraries to count: one row per library, each mapped once.
reads.help_text: Columns `library,sample,molecule,platform,fastq_1,fastq_2,strandedness`. Each library is mapped once onto the contigs of every assembly: DNA is counted on contigs and MAGs, RNA (Illumina) on genes. Without it, the run stops after the gene catalog. See docs/usage.md.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

mag_dereplication_options.title: MAG dereplication options
mag_dereplication_options.description: Which MAGs are good enough to keep, and when two of them are the same genome.

mag_ani.description: Average nucleotide identity above which dRep puts two MAGs in the same cluster (dRep `-sa`).
mag_ani.help_text: 0.95 is the usual species boundary: one MAG per species is kept. 0.99 keeps co-occurring strains of a species apart.

mag_ani_fine.description: Average nucleotide identity of a second, finer grouping of the dereplicated MAGs, cut from dRep's own tree.
mag_ani_fine.help_text: Must be at least `--mag_ani`. 0.98 is where dRep and inStrain consider two genomes distinct for read mapping. The groups are nested in dRep's clusters and reported next to them; the final MAGs do not change.

mag_min_completeness.description: Minimum CheckM2 completeness (%) for a MAG to be dereplicated and kept.
mag_min_completeness.help_text: A MAG below it is reported as `low_quality` and left out of the final MAGs; its genes still enter the gene catalog, as genes of no MAG.

mag_max_contamination.description: Maximum CheckM2 contamination (%) for a MAG to be dereplicated and kept.

mag_min_length.description: Minimum genome size (bp) for a MAG to be dereplicated and kept (dRep `-l`).

gene_catalog_options.title: Gene catalog options
gene_catalog_options.description: MMseqs2 thresholds of the gene dereplication. The same thresholds apply to the three clustering steps.

gene_min_seq_id.description: Minimum amino acid identity between a gene and its representative (MMseqs2 `--min-seq-id`).

gene_coverage.description: Minimum fraction of the alignment coverage required by `--gene_cov_mode` (MMseqs2 `-c`).

gene_cov_mode.description: Which sequence the coverage applies to: 0 both, 1 the member, 2 the representative (MMseqs2 `--cov-mode` of the clustering).
gene_cov_mode.help_text: With 1, a gene must be covered by its representative for at least `--gene_coverage` of its length, so fragments join the cluster of a full-length gene. The search of step 2 mirrors the mode, so that it keeps the same meaning there.

read_mapping_options.title: Read mapping options
read_mapping_options.description: Counting the read libraries of `--reads`, each mapped once onto every assembly: Illumina reads with bwa-mem2, long reads with minimap2.

ribo_database_manifest.description: Text file listing the rRNA databases SortMeRNA filters the RNA libraries against, one FASTA path or URL per line.
ribo_database_manifest.help_text: By default SortMeRNA's own databases (bacterial, archaeal and eukaryotic 16S/18S, 23S/28S, 5S and 5.8S), downloaded when the run starts. A relative path is looked up next to the manifest.

skip_rrna_removal.description: Map the RNA libraries as they are, without removing their rRNA reads first.
skip_rrna_removal.help_text: For reads already filtered. Otherwise rRNA reads that land on a predicted gene would be counted as its expression.

link_min_identity.description: Minimum identity for a stretch of an unbinned or low-quality contig to count as part of the MAG it aligns to.
link_min_identity.help_text: The reads that land on such a stretch are added to that MAG, so that a genome's reads are not lost to a copy of it no bin holds. Identity is the matching bases over the alignment length, gaps included. 0.98 is the ANI of the fine MAG groups (`--mag_ani_fine`); lower, more stretches of other strains, and of sequences several genomes share (plasmids, transposons, rRNA operons), link as well.

link_min_length.description: Minimum length (bp) of such a stretch.

save_bams.description: Publish the BAM of every library.

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).
